common_name: Flower Carpet Red Rose (Groundcover Shrub Rose)
subcategory: groundcover shrub rose, Flower Carpet series

planting.note: Transplant container-grown plants in spring into well-drained soil, spacing to let the wide-spreading mounds knit together into a solid groundcover; Flower Carpet Red is the deep red-flowered member of the Flower Carpet series.

directions: Plant in full sun in well-drained soil, watering deeply through the first growing season to encourage roots to spread beneath the wide, low canopy. Small, bright red semi-double flowers smother the spreading mounds almost continuously from late spring to frost, on the same vigorous, disease-resistant, low-maintenance habit that made the original Flower Carpet series a groundcover rose standard. Once established, it needs little care beyond an annual cutback in late winter to renew growth and encourage the heaviest bloom. Its dense habit suppresses weeds effectively and works well on slopes, in mass plantings, or cascading over retaining walls.
